title: Induction Machine Flux Observer
text: Induction machine flux observer for field-oriented control, 2 inputs, 4 outputs; {Rated electrical frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency, {Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)} sets the resistance, {Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)} sets the inductance, {Magnetizing inductance (pu)} sets the inductance, {Time constant for dq currents filters (s)} sets the time constant 1e-4 and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Rotor resistance, referred to the stator side (pu)
Rotor leakage inductance, referred to the stator side (pu)
Time constant for dq currents filters (s)
